messages:
maya: Heading to Denver next week for a small offsite (LoDo). Any recommendations for a quick weeknight spot — need outdoor seating, at least a couple veggie options, and room for 8. Also bonus if there's a good local beer list or tacos. ETA: Thursday 7pm.
nate: Ooh LoDo — check out Acme Taqueria on 17th. Solid veggie al pastor (jackfruit), decent patio. Gets busy though. :taco:
sophia: Also try Great Divide brewpub nearby for beer flight + small plates. Patio is nice and they can usually handle 8 if you reserve. https://greatdivide.com
leo: If you want tacos + beers in the same place, El Taco Bandito on Wazee has outdoor picnic tables and big trays. Not fancy but chill. Cheap drinks.
jess: For a quieter option w/ more seating, The Composition (LoDo Courtyard) has veggie bowls and ciders. Not many tacos but great for a mixed group.
maya: Love these — anyone have recs for call-ahead vs walk-in? We'll be on a tight schedule.
samir: Call ahead for Acme; they take group reservations after 6. Great Divide also accepts reservations for groups. El Taco Bandito is walk-in but they turn tables fast.
priya: If you need afro-latin vibes, Pueblo Kitchen does great plantains & has a covered patio — good if the weather's iffy.
maya: Perfect. Can someone pick one and I’ll block a table? Quick poll: vote with emoji — :one: Acme Taqueria, :two: Great Divide, :three: El Taco Bandito, :four: The Composition, :five: Pueblo Kitchen
nate: :one:
sophia: :two:
leo: :three:
jess: :four:
samir: :one:
priya: :five:
maya: Tally looks close — leaning Acme. I’ll call them now and post back the confirmation. Thanks all! :raised_hands:
maya: Reservation confirmed for 8 @ Acme Taqueria, Thu 7pm. Address: 1722 17th St. Dietary note: jackfruit taco for veg options. Parking on street or 2 nearby lots. See y’all there! (Reservation #A-4821)
ops-bot: Reminder set — event added to calendar Thu 7pm "Redwood LoDo Dinner at Acme Taqueria". RSVP: 8.
maya: Adding short note — bring layers, patio gets chilly after sunset. :jacket_with_arrow:
leo: Fleet of scooters nearby if anyone's coming from RiNo.
sophia: Excited! Beer flight for me. :beers:
